meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: 从 claude-mem 的观察记录里按项目、类型、概念等条件筛出语料，编译成知识库并载入 AI 会话，之后你可以就这些内容连续提问。
howto.when: 当你想把观察历史做成聚焦的知识库、想打听过去的工作模式，或就某个主题整理专长时触发。

say.text: 把 hooks-expertise 这个知识库载入会话
say.note: 调用 prime_corpus 载入知识

say.text: 问 hooks-expertise：5 个生命周期钩子分别何时触发？
say.note: 调用 query_corpus 从语料作答

howto.what_en: It filters your claude-mem observations into a corpus, loads that corpus into an AI session, and answers your questions from it. You can build, prime, query, list, rebuild and reprime corpora.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to turn your observation history into a focused knowledge base, ask about past work patterns, or compile expertise on a topic.

say_en.text: Build a knowledge base from my claude-mem observations, named hooks-expertise
say_en.note: Calls build_corpus to compile the corpus

say_en.text: Prime the hooks-expertise corpus into a session
say_en.note: Calls prime_corpus to load the knowledge

say_en.text: Ask hooks-expertise: what are the 5 lifecycle hooks and when does each fire?
say_en.note: Calls query_corpus to answer from the corpus
